summary: Inline cards and the panel caption render a compact 'read as' disclosure when question.bindings.subjects carries resolution_method model_selected or cached_model_selection with member_labels: the reader's phrase, the selected member names, and an explicit 'Assistant interpretation — not a source-declared group' tag. The distinction is structural (dashed left rule + wording), never colour alone. binding_id and selector stay out of the prose. Actions whose action_id begins correct-subject- render as 'Change this reading' when the producer sends no label, and are forwarded through the conversation like every action. Results without the additive fields render unchanged. Contract doc updated; fixture 11-model-selected-subject renders in the lab with the disclosure, the info limitation and the correction action.
